steps.en: Drivers who opted out are skipped and stay on letters
steps.id: Driver yang opt-out dilewati dan tetap lewat surat

steps.en: Other drivers get the electronic reminder
steps.why_en: The reminder job and text sending are switched off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dan pengiriman SMS dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.

steps.en: Driver notices heading to the 3rd letter are picked for checking
steps.id: Notice driver menuju surat ke-3 dipilih untuk dicek

steps.en: The driver's newest name and address are fetched and saved
steps.id: Nama dan alamat terbaru driver diambil dan disimpan
steps.why_en: An open defect in production keeps part of the results from being saved.
steps.why_id: Ada defect terbuka di produksi yang membuat sebagian hasil tidak tersimpan.

steps.en: Foreign ID holders are also checked
steps.why_en: The foreign-ID check is switched off, and passport holders have no check at all.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan ID asing dimatikan, dan pemegang passport tidak punya pengecekan sama sekali.
